headline: "Only to Putin We Will Not Go": Tofan Says Moldova Will Seek Long-Term Gas Supply Contracts
summary: Moldovan authorities intend to seek long-term gas supply contracts to lock in prices and reduce dependence on market fluctuations, according to Vasile Tofan.
why: Moldova relies heavily on imported natural gas, so long-term contracts can stabilise energy costs for households and industry.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: «Только к Путину мы не пойдем»: Тофан заявил, что Молдова будет искать долгосрочные контракты на поставку газа
